questions.prompt: count_lines throws because notes.txt is missing. What does the program send to the model?
options: A new user question asking for the right path
A tool_result with the same call id, the error text and is_error true
questions.explanation: The failure goes back as a result for the same call, marked is_error. The model can then read the cause and try another path.

questions.prompt: The model request itself fails because the API key is wrong. Should the program send it to the model as a tool error result?
options: No, the model cannot fix it, so the error ends the turn and goes to the user
Yes, every exception becomes a tool error result
Yes, so the model can choose a new key
No, the program should retry forever
questions.explanation: Only a failure inside a tool goes back to the model. A wrong API key is a failure of the program, which the model cannot fix.

questions.prompt: Why is "Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'notes.txt'" a better message than "Error"?
options: The API rejects short error messages
is_error only works with long messages
The model only gets the text, so the cause and the path help it choose the next request
questions.explanation: The model decides from the text it reads. Naming the missing path lets it try docs/notes.txt instead of repeating the same call.
